headline: Aid worker says hundreds remain trapped after Venezuela earthquakes
context: After earthquakes shattered much of the capital in Venezuela, Project Hope's Cesar Jimenez says rescue crews are racing to save hundreds trapped as international aid arrives and hospitals struggle to cope.
